diagnosed_cause: The checksum manifest included its own path and therefore could never validate after writing completed.
only_allowed_change: Exclude evidence/SHA256SUMS from the file set used to generate evidence/SHA256SUMS.
acceptance_rule: Launcher exit is zero; 12 clean repositories exist at the frozen commits; no fatal/error log signals or residual processes exist; every entry in the non-self-referential SHA256SUMS passes; timing and disk evidence exist.
prohibited_surfaces: parent source or run root mutation
